name: Garlic-Avocado Toast with Marinated Mozzarella, Basil & Side Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Mince the sun-dried tomatoes and place in a medium bowl. Add oil and spices; stir to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut mozzarella into ½-inch cubes and add to the bowl with the marinade; gently toss to coat the cheese and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkg fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and mince bell peppers; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Mince artichokes and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear lettuce leaves into bite-sized pieces and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice buns in half and divide between two baking sheet pans, cut-side up. Drizzle with garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 whole grain buns or rolls
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, place buns in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Set aside.
Halve and pit the avocados; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon. Arrange avocado slices on top of the garlic toast.
To serve, divide garlic-avocado toast and salad between plates; spoon marinated mozzarella over the toasts and garnish with basil. Enjoy!
